senses.gloss:
mfn. (-यः-या-पं)
Improper or unfit to be given.
E.
अ neg. देय to be given.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Receivable, leviable, what may be taken or received.
E.
आङ् before दा to give, यत् aff.

n. (-नं)
Giving what ought not to be given, what is not one's own, &c.
E.
अदेय, and दान giving.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
One who sports or plays.
E.
आङ्, दिन to sport, वुञ् aff.

m. (-शः)
1 An order, a command.
2 Advice, instruction.
3 (In grammar,) A substitute;
4 (In astrology,) Event, result, consequence of stellar conjunctions, &c.
E.
आङ्, दिश to point or shew, घञ् aff.

m. (-शी)
1 A commander, a director.
2 An astrologer, a fortune teller.
E.
आङ्, दिश to point or shew, and णिनि aff.

m. (-ष्टा)
1 An adviser, a director, a commander.
2 An employer of priests.
E.
आङ्, दिश to shew, तृच् aff.
